authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 12732 ślakṣṇa gives Gujarati nānũ, Oriya sāna small/youngest, and Marathi lahān small. The selected nāno/nānā/nāni, san and lāhān adjectives specify the younger sibling; source vowels and nasal notation are retained. The second component is brother (CDIAL 9661 bhrātṛ, regional bhāi/bhāū/bhrā). Two ordered etymological component links preserve the complete response; they do not assert one inherited Sanskrit compound or resolve internal Indo-Aryan transmission. Exact response: nānā bɦāy.
